For many internationals in the Maastricht Region, finding the right job can feel confusing and sometimes frustrating. We spoke with Sandrine de Goede, founder of Open Dutch Doors, about how to better understand the Dutch job market-and how to move forward with confidence. 
What are the main challenges that international professionals face when looking for work in the Netherlands? 
Language is often mentioned first. Even though many people in the Maastricht Region speak English with varied proficiency, employers still often ask for Dutch at a certain level. However, I think the bigger challenge is how internationals present themselves. They have strong experience, but it is not always clear to Dutch employers how this fits their specific needs. It is about making your value as an employee and as a person visible and understandable. 
Many internationals already have strong skills. Why can it still be difficult for them to find the right job? 
Internationals often have great soft skills, such as flexibility and perseverance. These are very valuable, but they are not enough on their own. Employers also want to see clear, practical skills. You need to explain what you can do in a specific role and why that matters to the employer. It is about connecting your experience to what the company is looking for. 
I work with a structured approach. First, we define a clear direction -what industry, what role, and which employers. Then we build a strategy around that. I help clients with their CV, their LinkedIn profile, interview preparation and where to look for jobs. This structure helps candidates feel more in control and less overwhelmed. It also builds confidence and reduces self-doubt. 
You often talk about "Dutchifying" a CV. What does this mean in simple terms?

Designer Plumbing Installations 
As Designer Plumbing Installations you will be focusing on designing systems that have sustainability and food security as starting points. 
( 17 augustus 2022 , Erik Schüssel ) 
For a client in the Delft region, active in the international high-tech horticultural sector, we are looking for a Designer Plumbing Installations. 
The Design Team works together with the Sales Department in drawing up quotations for customers globally. 
You will therefore be involved in making calculations, developing new systems, drawing up flow charts and visiting customers. You will be in frequent contact with colleagues and customers to ensure that the water systems or irrigation systems meet the customers' wishes. 
Who are we looking for in this position of Designer Plumbing Installations? 
- You have practical and technical insight 
- Completed technical education such as mechanical or installation engineering 
- Experience in water technology, installation technology or irrigation systems is a plus 
- You can speak English and Dutch is a nice to have 
You will be working in a team with 3 other colleagues with whom you will be working closely on challenging projects; every greenhouse needs a different system! 
There are many career opportunities and an attractive remuneration package (basic 35,000 - 50,000 euros/year, 32 days of holiday, travel allowance, pension scheme and a profit share scheme). 
Furthermore, as Designer Plumbing Installations you will be, on a daily basis, focusing on designing systems that have sustainability and food security as starting points.

As an operator, your main responsibility is to oversee the packaging of mangoes and avocados according to customer specifications. Subsequently, these yields are dispatched to supermarkets. Within this role, you will operate machinery and also supervise production staff working alongside you on the line. You will do this in English.

- Set up and adjust the net clipper or flowpack machines (performing light technical tasks).
- Supervise production workers.
- Ensure the smooth operation of the production line.
- Troubleshoot and resolve any issues that may arise.
- Perform administrative tasks on a computer to ensure all records and registrations are accurately maintained.
- Perform additional production tasks and maintain line cleanliness.

This is a full-time day shift position starting at 6:45 AM, concluding around 4:00 PM, with the possibility of extending hours for which you will receive a 135% overtime bonus after 38 hours worked per week. Weekends are off. However, it's important to note that the work environment is cold, with a temperature of 10 degrees Celsius, and you will be provided with appropriate warm clothing.

- Experience as an operator in an AGF environment, preferably with experience in using a net clipper or flowpack machine.
- Good command of the Dutch or English language.
- Leadership qualities.
- Full-time availability, preference for a permanent position.
- Own transportation is essential.
- Living near the Rotterdam, The Hague, Zoetermeer, Bleiswijk area.
